name: Gramps
description: Addon manager downloads .gpr.py registration files and exec()s them with no signature — and a macOS branch sets CERT_NONE/check_hostname=False (→ D on Mac).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The macOS addon URL helper sets CERT_NONE and disables hostname checking.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | Gramps | https://github.com/gramps-project/gramps.git | a32b463b / 2026-07-03 | Y (addon manager only; core app has no self-updater — distro/installer managed) | N (manual "Install Addon(s)" click) | Y (addon `.gpr.py` registration files are `exec()`'d directly after download) | https for addon list/download BUT code contains an explicit macOS branch that fully disables TLS verification (`CERT_NONE`, `check_hostname=False`) | N | none (no hash/signature check on downloaded addon zip/tarball contents) | server-supplied/unpinned (addon catalog + files served from gramps-project.org wiki, unauthenticated) | `gramps/gen/plug/utils.py:194-214` (`urlopen_maybe_no_check_cert` — CERT_NONE on mac()), `gramps/gen/plug/utils.py:337-394` (`load_addon_file` downloads zip/tar and `exec(contents, env)` on each `.gpr.py`), `gramps/gui/plug/_windows.py:1476-1484` (`__get_addon` UI entry point) |
